text:
Ethan: hi all, new hire here (Ethan) — first day. Trying to get my first PR in for `eng-infra/telemetry` but wanted a quick sanity check on branching and reviewers. quick q: do we use `feat/` vs `chore/` strictly?
Nina: welcome! For anything user-facing or behavioral use `feat/`. For infra/docs/ci use `chore/`. Bugfixes `fix/`. Keep the rest lowercase and hyphenated.
Jon: also include your initials: `feat/ej/telemetry-metrics` — makes it easier to find owners in git history.
Ethan: thanks — about reviewers: the CODEOWNERS file has most owners, but for infra we default to `eng-infra` + `eng-sre`. Who do I tag first?
Olivia: tag the area owner from CODEOWNERS and then add `eng-infra` and `eng-sre` in reviewers if it's infra touching runtime or deploys. Add `@oncall` only if this touches deploy scripts.
Nina: CI tip: if you see flaky integration tests, add `flaky: investigation` label and paste the failing log lines in the PR body. If it's clearly unrelated, re-run the job from the GH UI rather than pushing a new commit.
Ethan: makes sense. Also noticed our linter autofixes some files and changes import order. Is that expected?
Jon: yes, we use `isort` + `black`. Commit the autofixes in a separate commit and explain it in the PR body, e.g., "chore: apply formatter autofix". Keeps the real change easy to review.
Ethan: could someone pair with me for the first PR review? I want to walk through the telemetry flow and make sure I didn't miss any edge-cases. 20–30m would be great.
Olivia: I can do 30m at 10:30 PT. Drop the PR link here and @mention me.
